settings.question: What products are in the Complete Kit?
settings.answer: Refreshing Cleanser, 5% Niacinamide Serum, Calming Moisturiser, and Protecting Sunscreen SPF 50 — the full Cleanse → Treat → Moisturise → Protect system.

settings.question: How do I use the kit morning and night?
settings.answer: AM: Cleanse → Serum → Moisturise → Sunscreen. PM: Cleanse → Serum → Moisturise. Keep SPF for daytime only.

settings.question: Is it suitable if my skin is sensitive?
settings.answer: Patch test first. Introduce one new step at a time if your skin is reactive, and moisturise well.

settings.question: Can I buy the steps separately later?
settings.answer: Yes. Every product in the kit is also available individually when you’re ready to refill.

settings.question: Why buy the kit instead of singles?
settings.answer: You get a complete, sequenced routine with kit savings — and you don’t have to assemble the system yourself.
